semiconductor_relevance: High — ASK INDEX is directly involved in the semiconductor value chain through equipment sales, cleanroom construction, and training services.
summary: ASK INDEX specializes in buying and selling used semiconductor equipment, constructing cleanrooms, and providing contract manufacturing and prototyping services. They also operate a training facility for hands-on semiconductor manufacturing education.

regional_presence.Japan: Operates the Semiconductor Practical Training University in Minamata City, providing hands-on training in semiconductor manufacturing.
